stock.description: eprint Group Limited, an investment holding company, offers a wide array of printing services and solutions throughout Hong Kong, encompassing advertisements, bound books, and stationery. The company's business is segmented into Paper Printing and Banner Printing. Beyond its primary printing activities, it also extends its services to include digital printing, information technology and management consulting, and property investment. eprint Group serves clients through its network of retail shops and a dedicated self-service platform, while also engaging in the trading of optical products. Its well-known brands are e-print and e-banner. Established in 2001, the company maintains its headquarters in Kwun Tong, Hong Kong, and operates as a subsidiary of eprint Limited.
